title: Senior Go Engineer
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior Go Engineer. You will be responsible for leading the development of web applications using Go. You’ll work on the back-end, focusing on delivering efficient, scalable, and robust solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members to ensure seamless integration between the front-end and back-end.
  • Build efficient, reusable, and scalable code while following best practices for security and performance.
  • Develop RESTful APIs to power front-end applications and third-party integrations.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance to the team.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure the quality of the applications.


Technology Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer.
  • Deep understanding of Go programming language, including concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels), memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Experience building and deploying scalable and resilient backend services and APIs using Go frameworks (e.g., Gin, Echo, Fiber).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Extensive experience with Playwright for end-to-end testing of web applications is a plus.
  • Proven ability to design, develop, and maintain robust and reliable automated test suites.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, and Kubernetes for development and deployment.
  • Previous experience with high volume, high scale distributed systems.
  • Experience working with integration of

title: Lider Tecnico de Sustentação (FullStack)
description:
A Keyrus acredita na diversidade e na inclusão. Encorajamos a todos a participarem em nosso processo de contratação, não importando o gênero, idade, raça, religião. Não permitimos nenhum tipo de discriminação. Isto é reforçado no processo de contratação e vivido dessa forma na empresa.

Sabemos que grandes resultados só são alcançados com uma grande equipe, por isso procuramos pessoas talentosas e apaixonadas, com desejo de crescer profissionalmente e criar uma trajetória de carreira conosco.

Estamos em busca de um Líder Técnico de Sustentação (FullStack) para integrar nossa equipe. Esse profissional será responsável por liderar tecnicamente as operações, gerenciar prioridades técnicas, garantir a eficiência das entregas, identificar e mitigar riscos, além de atuar como um ponto de conexão entre diferentes áreas da empresa.

title: Country Operations Manager
description:
Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Location: Brazil/ Remote

Job Type: Full-time contract



About Trantor Inc

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.



Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.



About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.


What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.



Key Responsibilities


, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.


Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.


Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.


Financial & Market Insight Contribution

  • Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.



Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong track record in building trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.



Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Full-time employment
  • Remote work conditions

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java Pleno, em parceria com uma das maiores empresas de solução digital, voltada ao E-commerce que tem atuação em mais de 60 anos de história, com mais de 1.000 lojas físicas, 28 centros de distribuição e mais de 33 milhões de produtos no marketplace.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Microsserviços altamente concorrentes, usando linguagens de programação nas plataformas Java (6 a 17) e Spring;
  • Projete REST/Restfull APIs e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Construa aplicações usando os princípios de orientação à objetos;
  • Entregue aplicações resilientes, com baixa latência;
  • Ajude na criação dashboards intuitivos para monitoramento;
  • Investigue bugs e exceptions reportadas em produção;
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns;
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura de hexagonal de soluções;
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Banco de Dados relacional e não relacional;
  • Vivência com implementações de testes unitários;
  • Domain Driven Design, desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Design de API Rest/Soap de serviços;
  • Metodologia “12 factors”;
  • Conhecimento de frameworks ágeis;
  • Continuous Integration e Continuous Deployment utilizando Github Actions;
  • Mensageria Kafka;
  • Provider Azure e suas soluções;
  • RFCs.


Requisitos e qualificações


Você se encaixará bem se você:

  • Consiga se comunicar de maneira clara tanto com pessoas técnicas quanto não técnicas;
  • Tem atitude de dono e proatividade;
  • Facilidade de aprendizado e adaptação;
  • Já trabalhou em cultura ágil (Scrum, Kanban, Lean);
  • Gosta de desafios e debates;
  • Está familiarizado com mensageria (com Kafka, RabbitMQ ou similares);
  • É resiliente e flexível, pois estamos no processo de transformação digital.


Será diferencial se você:

  • Já trabalhou com arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Está familiarizado com Azure e suas soluções e outros providers (AWS, Google);
  • Conhece cultura DevOps;
  • Já ter atuado em projeto tributários/fiscais.

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a qualified Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll join our dynamic team, collaborating directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers to create intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. We’re looking for someone passionate about crafting outstanding user experiences and eager to stay current with evolving digital technologies.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to design and implement high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Use modern development standards and tools to create software applications that delight users.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Experience with browser compatibility testing and debugging
  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Familiarity with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Perfil Profissional – Desenvolvedor Java | Pleno

Desenvolvedor Java com sólida experiência em sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura de microsserviços, especializado em autenticação, autorização e protocolos de segurança como OAuth2, OpenID Connect e JWT. Atua com foco no desenvolvimento de mecanismos de Single Sign-On (SSO) para ambientes corporativos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade com padrões modernos de identidade digital.

Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Possui expertise na implementação de Identity Providers (IdP), Resource Servers e Authorization Servers, bem como na configuração de clients OAuth2 com grant types como Authorization Code, Client Credentials, e Refresh Tokens.

Também é responsável por definir estratégias de controle de acesso baseado em roles (RBAC) e atributos (ABAC), configuração de políticas de autorização, integração com diretórios corporativos (LDAP, AD), e hardening de endpoints REST com escopos e claims personalizados.

Competências Técnicas

Linguagem: Java 8–21

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Apache Camel

SSO & Identity: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML 2.0, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure Active Directory, Okta

Segurança: Criptografia, JWK/JWS, HTTPS/TLS, CORS, CSRF, PKCE

Integrações: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM

Testes: Testcontainers, JUnit, Mockito, integração com testes de segurança

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD com Jenkins, GitLab ou GitHub Actions

Diferenciais

Experiência na migração de sistemas legados para arquiteturas modernas com SSO.

Atuação direta no desenho e implementação de Identity Providers e Authorization Servers próprios.

Capacidade de liderar times na definição de padrões de autenticação e segurança em ambientes corporativos.

Vivência com compliance de segurança, como LGPD e GDPR, aplicando princípios de privacy-by-design.

Diferencial: com conhecimento em Autenticação, Autorização e SSO com OAuth2Habilidades:


Hardskills:


- Java

- Spring Boot

- Spring Security

- Spring Authorization Server

- OAuth2

- OpenID Connect

- JWT

- Keycloak

- Azure Active Directory

- Docker

- Kubernetes


Softskills:


- Autonomia, Proatividade e Iniciativa

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This is a remote position.

  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth.

Nice to Have:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer with extensive ITOM experience to lead the development and enhancement of our ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in CMDB, Discovery, Integrations, and related ITOM modules. Must be able to work in fast-paced environment, often requiring collaboration with various teams and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement complex ServiceNow ITOM solutions including CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping.
  • Experience with configuring and customizing ServiceNow applications and modules.
  • Lead development of integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance.
  • Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Provide solutions that utilize most out of the box features without requiring customizations. Facilitate the reuse of code, components, and proven patterns; Influence common modeling, design, and coding practices.
  • Perform upgrade testing by validating customizations, configurations, and integrations across major and minor ServiceNow releases.
  • Develop and maintain Automated Test Framework (ATF) test suites to validate core ServiceNow functionalities, ensuring stability and reducing manual regression efforts.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.
  • Maintain documentation for development and configuration.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of ServiceNow development experience with a focus on ITOM.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and Integrations.
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Glide API, REST/SOAP integrations, and ServiceNow scripting.
  • Experience with automation and DevOps practices, familiarity with continuous integration (CI/CD), code versioning tools such as Git, and Agile principles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to establish strong relationships internally and externally.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Experience with AI, Virtual Agent, Robot Process Automation (RPA)



this position pays $25/hr USD

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)


Raise 1,000 EU  Earn 20 EU- Micro partners/investors (global individuals)


Raise $100,000 EU  Earn 2,000 EU – Individuals | HNW | Small fund portfolios


Raise 5M EU  Earn 100,000 EU – UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios


Raise 10M EU  Earn 200,000 EU - UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 100M EU  Earn 2,000,000 EU - Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 1 Bill EU  Earn 20,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Raise 10 Bill EU  Earn 200,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Easy Next Step


Interested in joining the Magnum Equities Capital agent network?


Register as Capital Agent directly on Magnum's website:


Important Notes & Disclaimers


  • Magnum Equities does not require Capital Agents to hold securities licenses, as you are not directly soliciting or selling investment products. Only presenting partnership opportunity.
  • All commissions are distributed upon adequate clearing period.
  • All final post-placement due diligence, AML etc are handled internally by Magnum management.
  • This is a commission-only independent agent role. It is not an offer of employment, partnership, or representation, and no exclusivity or guarantees of earnings are provided.
  • Magnum Equities reserves the right to approve or reject capital partners at its sole discretion based on internal compliance protocols.

Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.

Register as Capital Agent directly on Magnum's website:

  • Magnum Equities does not require Capital Agents to hold securities licenses, as you are not directly soliciting or selling investment products. Only presenting partnership opportunity.
  • All commissions are distributed upon adequate clearing period.
  • All final post-placement due diligence, AML etc are handled internally by Magnum management.
  • This is a commission-only independent agent role. It is not an offer of employment, partnership, or representation, and no exclusivity or guarantees of earnings are provided.
  • Magnum Equities reserves the right to approve or reject capital partners at its sole discretion based on internal compliance protocols.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Sr. (HCM Sênior)
description:
MAIS QUE MERCADO

Somos parte de um dos maiores grupos varejistas do mundo, sendo o maior varejista do Brasil e um dos maiores empregadores privado do país, com mais de 130 mil pessoas colaboradoras, unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras.


Manifesto

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que a verdadeira inclusão começa com a valorização das diferenças e a criação de um ambiente onde cada pessoa pode ser autêntica e alcançar seu pleno potencial. Aqui, cada colaborador é respeitado e incentivado a trazer sua individualidade para o trabalho.

Nossa diversidade é a força que impulsiona nosso crescimento coletivo, criando um espaço de colaboração onde todos têm a oportunidade de prosperar.


O desenvolvimento profissional é parte essencial do que oferecemos. Acreditamos que o crescimento é uma jornada contínua, e por isso fornecemos as ferramentas e oportunidades necessárias para que cada colaborador possa expandir suas habilidades e evoluir dentro da empresa. Seja por meio da escola de líderes, programas afirmativos ou vagas internas, garantimos que todos possam avançar em seu próprio ritmo, construindo uma trajetória de sucesso dentro do Grupo.


A ascensão social faz parte do nosso compromisso em transformar vidas. Valorizamos o esforço e a dedicação, oferecendo caminhos claros para o crescimento. Muitos de nossos colaboradores que iniciaram suas carreiras em posições operacionais, como estoquistas ou operadores de caixa, têm a oportunidade de, por meio de nosso apoio e desenvolvimento contínuo, alcançar cargos de supervisão, gerência e até CEO.


No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que o sucesso não tem limites e todos podem crescer com

dedicação e apoio. Inclusão, desenvolvimento e ascensão social caminham JUNTOS.


Aqui, você pode ser você mesmo, evoluir como profissional e transformar a sua vida e a de sua família. Venha fazer parte dessa história!


Responsabilidades :

  • Garantir a disponibilidade e performance dos sistemas de RH, tais como: folha de pagamento, ponto eletrônico, benefícios, cargos e salários e remuneração.
  • Efetuar atendimento aos usuários na resolução de falhas, dúvidas e erros sistêmicos.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações entre HCM com sistemas terceiros, tais como SAP (contábil), Operadoras de Saude e Odonto, Gestão de Identidade, dentre outras
  • Mapear e automatizar rotinas do RH usando BPMs, RPA ou scripts (ex.:admissões, reajustes, movimentações internas).
  • Planejar e executar atualizações e versionamentos dos sistemas de RH, incluindo upgrades, testes de homologação e validações junto ao RH.
  • Apoiar projetos de transformação digital, participando da implantação de novas ferramentas e tecnologias para modernização do RH
  • Apoiar o RH na governança dos dados dos colaboradores, garantindo consistência, qualidade e conformidade com compliance e privacidade.


Você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento sólido no Sistema HCM da Sênior.
  • Experiência nos módulos folha de pagamento e eSocial, incluindo parametrizações, regras de CCT, contabilização, contracheque e eSocial (imprescindível);
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de regras de cálculo (imprescindível);
  • Experiência em customização de telas no SGI;
  • Domínio da linguagem LSP (imprescindível);
  • Conhecimento Plataforma X e Painel de Gestão (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Banco de Dados / CDBS;
  • Experiência com Senior Conect / Webservices (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em geração de relatórios.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções- Oracle
description:
Resumo

Profissional responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir soluções de integração e middleware, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura. Atua como referência técnica em plataformas SOA / OAG (Oracle API Gateway, Oracle SOA Suite) e em arquiteturas serverless com AWS Lambda, alinhando integrações legadas a soluções modernas em nuvem.

Principais Responsabilidades

Definir e manter a arquitetura de middleware (on-premises e cloud), suportando integrações críticas entre sistemas, parceiros e APIs externas.

Projetar soluções com OAG e Oracle SOA Suite, assegurando governança, segurança e políticas de API.

Liderar a migração e/ou modernização de integrações para AWS Lambda e outros serviços nativos da AWS (API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions).

Atuar na definição de padrões de integração, protocolos (REST, SOAP, JMS, eventos) e estratégias de mensageria.

Estabelecer guidelines de observabilidade e monitoramento (Dynatrace, CloudWatch, ELK).

Garantir alta disponibilidade e performance em integrações de missão crítica.

Apoiar squads e times de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de middleware e nuvem.

Conduzir avaliações de impacto técnico e provas de conceito (POCs) em novas tecnologias de integração.

Requisitos Técnicos

Middleware / SOA

Experiência com Oracle SOA Suite (BPEL, OSB, Mediator, Adapters).

Conhecimento profundo em Oracle API Gateway (OAG) e gestão de políticas de segurança (OAuth, JWT, rate limiting, throttling).

Integração via SOAP, REST, JMS, MQ, FTP, DB adapters.

Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.

Cloud (AWS)

Experiência em AWS Lambda e arquiteturas serverless.

Integração com API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions.

Conhecimentos em IAM (Identity and Access Management) e segurança em nuvem.

Monitoramento com CloudWatch e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Arquitetura

Definição de roadmaps de modernização para integrações legadas.

Aplicação de padrões de integração (EAI, ESB, event-driven).

Conhecimento em arquitetura de APIs (API-first, design RESTful, OpenAPI/Swagger).

Experiência em middleware híbrido (on-premises + cloud).

Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

Desejável

Experiência com Kong, Apigee ou outros API Gateways.

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes, OKE, EKS).

Certificações Oracle ou AWS (ex: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional).

Experiência em projetos com migração para nuvem.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Inteligência Artificial - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).
  • Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines.
  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Desenvolvimento Java + Kotlin AWS Sênior - 125663
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Java + Kotlin AWS


Requisitos:

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com sólidos conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS. Procuramos alguém com paixão por tecnologia, habilidades em resolver problemas complexos e experiência em ambientes de nuvem. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações back-end em Java 17+ e Kotlin, assegurando alta performance e escalabilidade. Projetar e implementar soluções em AWS, utilizando serviços como: Mensageria com Kafka e SQS, Serverless com Lambda e Step Functions, DevOps com GitHub Actions e Terraform, Cloud AWS: DynamoDB, Step Functions, Lambda, ECS, ECR, S3, SQS, SNS, Batch, Glue, Observabilidade com Datadog, Grafana e Prometheus Integrar as aplicações Java com a infraestrutura na nuvem, garantindo eficiência e segurança. Colaborar com a equipe de DevOps para automatizar processos de build, deploy e monitoramento utilizando CI/CD e outras ferramentas. Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de práticas como revisão de código, testes automatizados e aplicação de design patterns. Monitorar, otimizar e manter os serviços e recursos AWS para garantir alta disponibilidade e custo-benefício. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outros desenvolvedores e stakeholders para alinhar requisitos de negócio com soluções técnicas. Participar ativamente em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a produção. Requisitos: Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 17+/Kotlin, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

title: KYC Analyst（remote）
description:
Responsibilities:


Conduct international verification case reviews, including individual and corporate verifications.

Review and confirm the results of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and economic sanctions blacklist screenings.

Coordinate with other departments on KYC/CDD-related workflows and process daily applications.

Assist in optimizing the global customer KYC/CDD process.

Analyze KYC vendor review situations and seek better solutions.

Assist in monitoring the daily status of KYC/CDD and check the system's operation.

Conduct research on the KYC/CDD regulatory requirements and documentation for different countries and complete the research report.

Assist in the implementation of AML policies and other policies involving KYC/CDD.

Responsible for dealing with difficult KYC problems related to Portuguese, Spanish if applicable.

Support the Team Leader in completing other related tasks.


Position Requirements:


A bachelor's degree or higher in finance, law, economics, auditing, languages or related fields from a full-time university program (preference for graduates from internationally renowned universities). Proficiency in Mandarin is preferred.

At least two years of experience in KYC/CDD or other compliance-related roles within banks, securities, or other financial institutions is preferred.

Proficiency in English, with the ability to use English as a working language.

Portuguese or Spanish is the native language.

Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering and international economic sanctions theories; CAMS certification is a plus.

A stable personality with a strong sense of compliance and responsibility, strong learning and stress tolerance abilities, good communication skills, meticulous work, high enthusiasm, and a sense of responsibility.

Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in using office software such as Excel, Word, PPT.

title: SR Desenvolvimento Back-end (Java)
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 5° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Requisitos:

  • Inglês Avançado.
  • Proficiência em Java com foco em frameworks modernos, especialmente Quarkus .
  • Conhecimento em Node.js ou Go para desenvolvimento de serviços complementares.
  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle , PostgreSQL ) e NoSQL (MongoDB , DynamoDB ).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microserviços , incluindo padrões de comunicação (REST , gRPC ).
  • Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos , utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ , Kafka e Amazon SQS .
  • Domínio em contêineres e orquestração com Docker e Kubernetes .
  • Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins , GitHub Actions , ArgoCD ).
  • Uso avançado de Git e fluxos colaborativos (Gitflow , revisão de código).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus , Grafana , ELK Stack ).
  • Implementação de testes robustos (unitários, integração, e2e) com frameworks como JUnit , Mockito e Testcontainers .
  • Adoção de boas práticas de TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
  • Trabalho colaborativo em equipes ágeis (Scrum , Kanban ).
  • Experiência em projetos com grande volume de transações e alta escalabilidade .
  • Contribuição para refatoração e melhoria contínua de código e arquitetura.
  • Conhecer conceitos de aplicabilidade no uso de aplicacoes distribuidas
  • Cloud-provide (OpenShift )


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com observabilidade (Tracing, Metrics, Logging).
  • Domínio em ferramentas como OpenAPI e Swagger para documentação de APIs.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Business Development Representative - BDR/Saas/B2B - Nível Jr/Pleno (100% home office / remoto)
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Se você possui ao menos 2 anos de experiências com vendas de produto SAAS para empresas (B2B), tem ambição e sabe administrar uma rotina com metas, você é a pessoa certa para nossa vaga, vem crescer com a gente!


A posição é para BDR (focado em Prospecção Ativa/Outbound), mas o colaborador irá executar atividades na área de pré-vendas em geral (inbound/outbound).


Informações Gerais

- Local: remoto;

- Modalidade: 100% home office;

- Formato: PJ;

- Remuneração: a combinar;

- É necessário ter o próprio equipamento (computador/headset) e acesso à internet.


Responsabilidades

- Principais funções: Pré-vendas (cold call, whatsapp, linkedin) com o objetivo de efetuar agendamento de reunião com leads, utilização de CRM, etc., social selling, estruturação de cadência, etc.;

- Trabalho direto com os sócios e plano de carreira com possibilidade de crescimento acelerado.


Qualificações

- Graduação concluída em qualquer área;

- Excelente comunicação (verbal e escrita);

- Desejo de crescer;

- Forte capacidade de argumentação;

- É essencial ter motivação, proatividade e paixão por vendas.

title: FBS HR Jr Analyst
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premium well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

Location: Brazil/Mexico – Working Hours: 8:00 am to 5:00 pm (EST)


What You’ll Do:

You will provide operational and administrative support to the HR department. Assisting with all HR responsibilities as needed in either a general or specialized HR department. Communicating with individuals throughout the organization and externally.

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Communications - Intermediate
  • Collaboration & Partnership - Intermediate

  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development
  • Performance Bonus

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Mapear e modernizar uma aplicação .NET para uma arquitetura de microsserviços em Java;

- Projetar e desenvolver novos microsserviços com Spring Boot;

- Garantir estabilidade da plataforma durante a transição;

- Trabalhar com Docker, Kubernetes (GKE) e Google Cloud Platform;

- Planejar e executar estratégias de migração de dados (SQL e NoSQL);

- Promover qualidade e excelência técnica com testes automatizados e CI/CD.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend Java (8+);

- Domínio em Spring Boot, Spring MVC e Spring Security;

- Vivência com microsserviços, containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub);

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Business Analyst (TAX)
description:
Business Analyst (TAX)


***Add resume in English***


Activities:


• Serves as a Tax, Sourcing, Travel, Expense, and Real Estate applications subject matter expert associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient.

• Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and technology staff, including off-shore personnel, to ensure that communication is open and ongoing.

• Serves as a liaison between technical and functional stakeholders and project management teams to keep initiatives moving forward smoothly and in accordance with project plans.

• Defines project scope, project strategy, deliverable priorities, and recommend alternative solutions.

• Define detailed requirements, analyze business needs, and validate solutions with the internal partners.

• Coordinate project activities, prepare agendas, document meeting outcomes, and collaborate with team members.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.


Requirements:

• Advanced English.

• Relevant experience working with Tax, Sourcing, Shared Services, Travel, Expense, or Real Estate applications.

• Application configuration, design, and interface experience.

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions.

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies.

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes, including but not limited to Tax, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense, and Real Estate.

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project.

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills.

title: FBS Sr Finance Analyst
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premium well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

Location: Brazil/Mexico – Working Hours: 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (PST)


What You’ll Do:

You’ll develop the IT annual budget and obtains sign-off by budget owners; prepare IT cost allocations to the business units for IT services and any assigned financial reports; monitor expenditures for assigned services, ensuring compliance with corporate policies; identify ways to automate processes, increasing efficiency and accuracy; review financial implications of new system initiatives and prepares financial analysis reports in support of new projects.


Experience:

  • 5 years of experience.


Skills:

  • Proficiency in English (The interview’ll be in English)
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
  • Accounting – Intermediate
  • Forecasting – Intermediate
  • Management Presentation - Entry Level
  • SAP - Intermediate
  • Excel - Advanced


  • Competitive compensation and benefits package:
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development
  • Performance Bonus


Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Motion Web Designer
description:
About you:

As a Motion Web Designer, you’ll play a central role in shaping visually compelling and accessible web experiences that balance aesthetics with functionality.


You bring to the team the following competencies:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative or visual design roles, ideally in digital environments.
  • Mastery of Lottie Files and light motion design for icons and interactive elements.
  • Familiarity with Figma for crafting responsive web designs.
  • Experience creating and editing video content for hero sections, homepage banners, or other dynamic assets.
  • Strong understanding of ADA compliance principles for web accessibility:
  • Ability to adapt and recycle pre-approved design elements while maintaining consistency and accessibility.
  • A refined eye for layout, typography, color, and visual hierarchy .
  • Basic understanding of UI and usability principles to ensure function supports form.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design visually impactful, ADA-compliant landing pages and UI components using Figma.
